rule.name: ChangeNamedEquality
rule.message: A name that says something changed is computed as plain equality: isModified() or a hasChanged variable holds a.equals(b), so it is true exactly when nothing differs. A settings page then never offers Apply, or listeners fire on every refresh except real changes, and the code still compiles. Negate the comparison (return !current.equals(initial);, boolean hasChanged = !Objects.equals(saved, edited);), or rename the method or variable to say what it tests (isUnchanged). An exception fits a name that says the values match.
